QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR WEB DEV
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Web Dev cost in Dublin?

Quoted per project after a free review. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Dublin?
Yes. We work with businesses in Dublin and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
How long does a website take to build?
A typical 10–20 page marketing website takes 6–10 weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger or more complex projects take longer. We'll give you a precise timeline in the project proposal.
Do you work with existing brands or start from scratch?
Both. We work with your existing brand identity or can recommend a brand refresh as part of the project.
Can you build e-commerce sites?
Yes. We build on Shopify for most e-commerce projects, or custom Next.js for businesses with specific requirements.
Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
Yes. Monthly maintenance retainers cover updates, security patches, backups, and minor content changes.
